start.title: Yukarıdan Gelen Ses
start.text:
Tanrı seninle konuşur.
"Kendine bir gemi yap. Bir tufan geliyor."

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Receive God's command to build an ark of cypress wood
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis 6:14, 22 — God told Noah to make an ark of cypress wood, and Noah did everything just as God commanded.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Refuse the command and flee the land
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis says Noah obeyed God; he did not flee.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Buy an existing ship from a merchant
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis says Noah built the ark himself, as God instructed.

mockery.title: İzleyen Bir Dünya
mockery.text:
Etrafındaki dünya yozlaşmış ve şiddet dolu.
Seni inşa ederken izliyorlar. Nasıl karşılık verirsin?

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Keep building the ark by faith
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Hebrews 11:7 — By faith Noah built the ark in reverent fear, though warned of things not yet seen.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Abandon the ark to please the crowd
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Scripture says Noah kept building by faith.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Attack the mockers to silence them
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Scripture does not describe Noah attacking anyone.

building.title: Selvi ve Zift
building.text:
Tanrı'nın emrettiği malzemeleri toplarsın.
Gemiyi nasıl inşa edersin?

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Build it of cypress wood, coated with pitch inside and out
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis 6:14 — Make yourself an ark of cypress wood; coat it with pitch inside and out.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Build it from cut stone
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis says the ark was built of cypress wood, not stone.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Weave it from reeds like a basket
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis says the ark was made of cypress wood, sealed with pitch.

ark_done.title: Tamamlandı
ark_done.text:
Gemi tamamlandı, tıpkı Tanrı'nın emrettiği gibi.
Nasıl görünüyor?

choices.text: [TODO:tr] 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis 6:15-16 — The ark was 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] A small round boat with one deck
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis gives specific dimensions; the ark was not a small round boat.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] A raft, flat and open to the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis says the ark had a roof, three decks, and a door in its side.

animals.title: Canlılar Geliyor
animals.text:
Hayvanlar gemiye varır.
Kimi gemiye alırsın?

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Take pairs of every kind of animal, male and female
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis 7:8-9 — Pairs of clean and unclean animals, birds and creeping things came to Noah, male and female.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Take only sheep and goats
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis says every kind of animal came, not only sheep and goats.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Take no animals — only your family
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis says the animals came into the ark with Noah.

boarding.title: Kapı Kapandı
boarding.text:
Gemiye girme zamanı.
Kimler girer ve kapıyı kim kapatır?

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Enter with your wife, three sons, and their wives; the Lord shuts the door
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis 7:13, 16 — Noah, his wife, his three sons and their wives entered the ark, and the Lord shut him in.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Enter the ark alone, leaving your family behind
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis says Noah's whole household entered the ark with him.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Stay outside and close the door from without
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis says the Lord Himself shut Noah inside the ark.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Rain falls on the earth for forty days and forty nights
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis 7:12 — Rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] A single storm passes in one day
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis says the rain fell for forty days and nights.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Only a light drizzle falls
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis describes the fountains of the deep bursting and the windows of heaven opening.

inside.title: Sular Üzerinde
inside.text:
Gemi derin sular üzerinde yüzer.
Sular yeryüzünde ne kadar süre hüküm sürer?

choices.text: [TODO:tr] The waters flood the earth for a hundred and fifty days
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis 7:24 — The waters flooded the earth for a hundred and fifty days.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] The waters recede in three days
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis says the waters prevailed 150 days before receding.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] You steer the ark back toward Eden
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis does not describe Noah steering the ark; God kept it afloat.

dove.title: Güvercin Geri Döner
dove.text:
Sular çekilmeye başlar.
Kuru toprağın yakın olduğunu nasıl anlarsın?

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Send out a dove; it returns with a fresh olive leaf
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis 8:11 — The dove returned to Noah in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Send out a raven that returns with grain
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis says the dove — not the raven — brought back an olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Open the roof and look with your own eyes only
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis says Noah sent out birds to test whether the waters had gone down.

dry_land.title: Ayaklarının Altındaki Toprak
dry_land.text:
Rab sana gemiden çıkmanı söyler.
Kuru toprağa ilk çıktığında ne yaparsın?

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Build an altar to the Lord and offer sacrifices
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis 8:20 — Noah built an altar to the Lord and offered burnt offerings on it.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Begin building a great tower right away
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis says Noah's first act was to build an altar, not a tower.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Refuse to leave the ark
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Genesis says Noah came out of the ark when God told him to.

covenant.title: Gökkuşağı
covenant.text:
Gökyüzünde bir gökkuşağı belirir.
"Yeryüzünü bir daha asla sular altında bırakmayacağım. Bu sizinle yaptığım antlaşmadır."
